add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(dpnhupnp.dll dpnhupnp.spec)

# dpnhupnp.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dpnhupnp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dpnhupnp_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(dpnhupnp_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dpnhupnp_shims)
add_dependencies(dpnhupnp_shims wineheaders)
add_cargo_module(dpnhupnp dpnhupnp-cargo dpnhupnp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dpnhupnp_shims psdk uuid_sources)
